quickAnswer: **Matomo** is the best fit when you need **GA-like depth with full data ownership** — self-hosted or EU cloud — and strong privacy controls. Skip it if you want zero ops and a five-minute setup — **Plausible** or **Fathom** are faster for simple marketing analytics.
bestFor: Organizations with **GDPR, HIPAA, or data-residency** requirements
Teams wanting **on-prem or self-hosted** analytics without Google processing
Sites needing **ecommerce, goals, and custom dimensions** beyond lightweight tools
Agencies managing multiple client properties from one Matomo instance
notFor: Founders who want install-and-forget cloud analytics in 15 minutes
Teams without anyone to **maintain, patch, and backup** self-hosted software
Product-led teams needing feature flags and session replay — **PostHog** fits better
Indie Stripe revenue attribution — **DataFast** is more direct

sections.title: Data ownership
sections.content:
Matomo's headline advantage is **you own the data**. Self-hosted deployments store hits on your servers; Matomo Cloud keeps data in managed EU or other regions depending on plan. This appeals to public sector, healthcare-adjacent, and EU companies wary of Google Analytics transfers.

Matomo can import GA data historically and mirrors many UA-era concepts teams already understand — easing migration psychologically even if GA4's model differs.

Ownership comes with responsibility: backups, upgrades, and security patching for self-hosted installs.

sections.title: Feature depth
sections.content:
Matomo covers **web analytics, ecommerce, goals, funnels, custom dimensions, and tag manager** (Matomo Tag Manager). Plugin marketplace extends media analytics, A/B testing, and more.

Depth approaches GA4 for many marketing use cases while staying privacy-configurable — including **cookieless tracking** modes and anonymization options. It is still primarily **web analytics**, not a full product analytics suite.

Heatmaps and session recording exist via plugins or integrations but are not as polished as Hotjar out of the box.

sections.title: Matomo Cloud vs On-Premise (self-hosted)
sections.content:
Matomo comes in two hosting models, and both keep 100% data ownership.

| | Matomo Cloud | Matomo On-Premise |
|---|---|---|
| Who hosts it | Matomo, on its servers | You, on your own servers |
| Data location | Frankfurt, Germany | Wherever you put your servers |
| Price | from $29/month for 50K hits | Core software free (Community); paid plugin bundles from €230/month |
| Updates, backups, security | Included: hosting, maintenance, automatic updates, security monitoring, daily backups | Your job |
| Premium features (funnels, heatmaps, A/B tests) | Included in Cloud plans | Bought as plugins or bundles (Team, Business, Enterprise) |
| Limits | Business plan: 30 websites, 30 team members, 24 months raw data retention, reports kept forever; over 10M hits/month is custom | Community: unlimited users and hits |

**Choose Cloud** if nobody on your team wants to run PHP and a database, patch servers and test backups. **Choose On-Premise** if you need data in a specific country or on your own infrastructure, or if your traffic makes per-hit pricing expensive.

You can switch later: Matomo will import On-Premise data into Cloud or export Cloud data for self-hosting.

### Matomo hosting: what self-hosting actually costs
The software is free, but you still pay for a server, a database, SSL, backups and someone to apply updates. Paid On-Premise bundles (per matomo.org, Oct 2026) are Team from €230/month (up to 5M hits, 4 users), Business from €1,209/month (up to 30M hits, 20 users) and Enterprise from €2,834/month (up to 100M hits, 50 users). Server sizing depends on traffic; see Matomo's [installation docs](https://matomo.org/docs/installation/) for requirements.

### Backups
Matomo Cloud includes daily backups. On-Premise, back up the database and config yourself and test restores, since a lost database means lost history.

setupNotes:
**Typical setup (cloud):**

1. Create a Matomo Cloud site or install self-hosted on your server.
2. Add the **tracking JavaScript** snippet or use Matomo Tag Manager.
3. Configure **goals**, ecommerce (if applicable), and user privacy settings.
4. Set up **consent** integration if required in your regions.
5. Validate tracking with Matomo's real-time debugger.

Self-hosted production installs need SSL, backups, and ongoing updates in addition to the tracking snippet.

**Common pitfalls:** under-resourced self-hosting, misconfigured cookieless mode breaking attribution, and comparing "hits" to GA4 "events" without alignment.
pricingNotes:
Matomo Cloud uses **monthly hit tiers** from **$29/50K hits** up to **$389/1M hits** in our directory. Self-hosted software is free; you pay hosting, SSL, backups, and engineer time.

Plugins and support contracts add cost on self-hosted. For tiny blogs, Plausible is cheaper and simpler. For regulated mid-size sites, Matomo's TCO can beat GA4 once legal and export work is counted.

Use our [pricing calculator](/calculators/pricing/) with your hit/pageview estimates.
limitations: Self-hosted ops burden is non-trivial — not a weekend project at scale.
UI and onboarding are less modern than Fathom/Plausible for casual users.
Product analytics, flags, and replay are not native core strengths.
Plugin ecosystem quality varies — vet before production dependency.
Script performance benchmark pending on AnalyticsVS.

faq.question: Matomo vs Google Analytics 4?
faq.answer: Choose Matomo for data ownership, EU hosting options, and privacy configurability. Choose GA4 for free scale and Google Ads integration depth.

faq.question: Is Matomo really GDPR-friendly?
faq.answer: Matomo provides tools for anonymization, consent, and EU hosting, but compliance depends on your configuration and legal context — not the logo alone.

faq.question: Matomo vs Plausible?
faq.answer: Plausible for simplicity and speed. Matomo when you need deeper reporting, ecommerce, or self-hosting with GA-like flexibility.

faq.question: Matomo Cloud vs On-Premise: which should I choose?
faq.answer: Choose Matomo Cloud if you want Matomo without running servers: hosting, updates, security monitoring and daily backups are included, and data is stored in Frankfurt, Germany. Choose On-Premise if you need full control of where data lives or have the engineering time to maintain it.

faq.question: Is self-hosted Matomo free?
faq.answer: The core Matomo On-Premise software (Community) is free with unlimited users and hits, but you pay for hosting and maintenance. Premium features such as funnels, heatmaps and A/B testing are paid plugins or bundles, starting from €230/month for the Team bundle.

faq.question: Can I move from Matomo On-Premise to Matomo Cloud later?
faq.answer: Yes. Matomo says it can import data collected On-Premise into Cloud, or export Cloud data for you to self-host.
